confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from mixed-age, partly crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregators and a small set of venue menus and happy-hour listings dated 2023 to 2026. Some sources used unclear currencies, and the mid-range three-course meal has the widest spread. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Byron Bay, not from live booking pages or current listings, and July school-holiday peak rates add uncertainty. Accommodation is the lowest-confidence group. AUD-based estimates were expressed in USD at the returned RBA rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors rest on Byron Bay-specific cost-of-living aggregators and sampled Byron venue menus and happy-hour listings. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of Byron Bay's coastal resort-town pricing in the July 2026 window.
